text: What happened in April 2001 at Padua/Pyrdiwah and Boraibari? A short but intense Bangladesh-India border clash unfolded across disputed frontier sectors.
Why is Boraibari remembered? It marked the deadliest phase of the 2001 crisis and drove urgent military-to-military de-escalation.
Border ambiguity and tactical escalation can outrun political intent in days.
